title: readProjectOverview
responsibility: Reads and projects local tracker data for the Explorer and the native bridge, mapping failures to an unavailable state.

inputs.name: readProjectOverview.fetcher
inputs.description: The fetch implementation for the fixed loopback GET requests.

inputs.name: readProjectOverview.now
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds used to compare tracker timestamps.

outputs.name: readProjectOverview
outputs.description: The display-ready tracker snapshot or the unavailable state when the local source fails.
